Sticky Notes App

Colorful sticky notes on a board — add, edit, recolor and delete notes. Everything auto-saves in your browser.

No notes yet — add one above. Notes save automatically.

📖 How to use

  1. Click “+ New note”.
  2. Type your note — it saves as you type.
  3. Change its color from the palette.
  4. Delete notes you no longer need.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are my notes saved?

Yes — notes are saved in localStorage and restored on every visit, edits included.

What colors are available?

Six colors: yellow, pink, green, blue, purple and orange.

Can I edit a note?

Click a note's text to edit it inline — changes save automatically.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — the board wraps nicely on small screens.
